reason: ContentTypeDefinitionDriverOptions has no default values set (bool fields default to false), so the new GetOptions fallback (_defaultOptions) would hide the Creatable/Listable/Draftable/Versionable/Securable checkboxes for every content type that isn't explicitly registered in the new Stereotypes/ContentTypes dictionaries, silently removing standard admin UI controls from all existing sites/tenant
